supervised_yolo.supervision: Supervised (Requires labeled bounding boxes for all 6 defect types)
strengths: Classifies specific defect taxonomy (crazing vs patches vs rolled-in scale)
Sub-pixel bounding box localization ready for robotic sorting
High mAP on known defects (90%+ mAP50)
weaknesses: Zero zero-shot capability on novel unseen metallurgical defect types
Requires high annotation cost (thousands of labeled boxes)
supervised_yolo.recommended_use_case: Standard production line with well-defined defect taxonomies and strict grading specs.

unsupervised_patchcore.supervision: Unsupervised / One-Class (Trained strictly on defect-free 'golden' steel coils)
strengths: Zero defect annotation required; learns only what normal steel looks like
Flags novel, unexpected, or ultra-rare defect morphologies as out-of-distribution
weaknesses: Cannot classify defect type (e.g. cannot distinguish scratch from inclusion)
Sensitive to non-defect illumination variations unless robustly calibrated
unsupervised_patchcore.recommended_use_case: New manufacturing lines, scarce failure data, or early-stage exploratory QA.
